About Bothbest Bamboo

Anji-based specialist bamboo manufacturer since 2001, supplying importers, distributors, architects, and project contractors across 40+ countries.

Since 2001 Factory Direct ISO 9001 & 14001 Certified FSC & CE Compliant 40+ Countries Exported
Source Manufacturer

Dedicated Exclusively to Rapidly Renewable Bamboo

Bothbest is a China-based manufacturer focusing exclusively on Moso bamboo building materials. We produce a complete product portfolio including solid and strand woven bamboo flooring, thermo-treated outdoor bamboo decking, multi-layer bamboo plywood panels, veneer, and custom architectural bamboo.

Our manufacturing base sits in Anji, Zhejiang—China’s core Moso bamboo heartland—where mature bamboo forests are harvested sustainably on a rotating cycle. Equipped with automated precision profiling lines, high-tonnage hydraulic hot presses, and strict VOC testing protocols, we deliver stable, wear-resistant boards trusted across Europe, North America, and Australia.

Bothbest operates under ISO 9001 quality management and ISO 14001 environmental management standards, ensuring repeatable consistency from sample approval to full container shipment.

ISO 9001 Quality ISO 14001 Environment FSC Certified CE Low-VOC
Sustainability

Our Eco Mission

Our mission is to manufacture durable, non-toxic, and ecologically sustainable bamboo building materials that deliver factory-direct value and responsive service to global distributors, architects, builders, and homeowners.

Because Moso bamboo matures for harvest in 4–6 years compared to 25+ years for traditional hardwoods, maximizing bamboo utilization actively reduces slow-growth timber logging while providing superior structural hardness.
